This issue is public. Do not include router passwords, Wi-Fi passwords, IMEI, MAC address, SSID or local IP address.

Reports from the Android app include structured metadata processed by GitHub Actions. The app asks for confirmation before opening this draft. You must sign in and manually submit the issue.

For manual reports, include:

- Router model:
- Hardware revision:
- Firmware version:
- App version:
- In-app test result:
- Valid battery percentage read?:
- Did the low-battery Android notification arrive? (separate from router compatibility):
- Additional notes:
